sources.title: British Indian Ocean Territory Administration, Current travel advice
sources.said: The British Indian Ocean Territory is not a tourist destination. Access is restricted and a permit is required in advance of travel. There are no commercial flights and permits are only issued to yachts for safe passage. Access to Diego Garcia is only for those on pre-authorised official duty.

sources.title: British Indian Ocean Territory Administration, Applying for a permit
sources.said: Permits are required in advance of travel. They can take 8 weeks to process; please apply for a permit well in advance of your intended arrival dates. All visitors to the territory require an immigration permit … The immigration permit system is official permission granted by the BIOT Administration for a person or group to enter and stay in BIOT for an approved purpose and duration. … There is a £100 fee for processing applications, this must be paid before processing can begin. Please note, if you are paying from an international (non-UK) bank account, you will need to add £7 to transfers … commercial activity (including charter trips and fishing other than for subsistence purposes) are strictly prohibited

sources.title: The British Indian Ocean Territory (Immigration) Order 2004, ss. 7-8 (BIOT Administration, Orders in Council)
sources.said: 7. – An immigration officer, acting in his entire discretion, may issue or renew a permit or may cancel a permit before its expiration, subject to the right of appeal provided by section 10. Duration of permits 8. – A permit shall, unless cancelled, remain in force for a period of four years from the date of issue or for such shorter period as is stated in it. A permit renewed shall, unless … cancelled, remain in force for a period of four years from the date on which the renewal takes effect or for such shorter period as is stated in the renewed permit.

note: No permit for a paid performing engagement exists: permits go to yachts for safe passage and to official duty on Diego Garcia, and commercial activity is prohibited. The game should treat paid work here as unavailable, not as a permit to get.
